test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 02 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The value of a machine depreciates by 10% per annum. If its present value is ₹72,900, find its value 2 years ago.
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Depreciation rate = 10% = 1/10

Ratio of Initial value to Final value for 1 year = 10 : 9

Ratio for 2 years = 10² : 9² = 100 : 81

81 units = ₹72,900 ⇒ 1 unit = ₹900

Initial value (2 years ago) = 100 units = 100 × 900 = ₹90,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹90,000.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Present Value (V) = ₹72,900

Rate of depreciation (r) = 10% per annum

Time (n) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Present Value = Value 2 years ago × (1 − r/100)ⁿ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82b6e25d58b538e87e991d908128c540b3bac2956b3658b14af625b32fbeb829.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 72,900 = Value 2 years ago × (1 − 10/100)²

⇒ 72,900 = Value 2 years ago × (90/100)²

⇒ 72,900 = Value 2 years ago × (9/10)²

⇒ 72,900 = Value 2 years ago × 81/100

⇒ Value 2 years ago = (72,900 × 100) ÷ 81

⇒ Value 2 years ago = 900 × 100

⇒ Value 2 years ago = 90,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹90,000.**

**__Additional Information__**

Appreciation Formula

If the value of an asset increases over time, the formula used is A = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ.

Successive Percentage Change

For two successive changes of a% and b%, the effective net change is given by (a + b + ab/100)%.

Population Growth/Decline

The same depreciation and appreciation principles are applied to calculate population changes over a period of years.
